name: Titan Scroll: Eonar kill hook casts the ground heal in the open world
contract: With aura 993957 active, mod-coa-titan-scrolls' OnPlayerCreatureKill hook rolls 10% per kill and, outside a capital city, casts spell 993963 (Eonar's Blessing) at the kill location with BASE_POINT0/1 set to a flat 5% of the killed creature's max health per tick (matches the buff's own native tooltip; the buff does not stack). The spell ticks 5 times over its duration, so the total delivered is 25% of the killed creature's max health. ProcFlags is 0 on 993957 in the DBC, so this can only be a script cast, never a native aura proc — spell_cast_count (not spell_proc_count) is the correct observation.

steps.label: No buff active yet: killing must never cast the ground heal (deterministic, no RNG involved when the aura is absent)
At least one of 7 buffed kills at 10% procced the ground heal (P(0 successes) = 0.9^7 ~= 48%; if this flakes, raise creature count rather than the chance)
Heal-per-tick lands on the killer (not a nearby enemy): flat 5% of the killed creature's 1000 max health per tick (1000*5/100=50)
